name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 15 – Am 13
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 15a. Calls on the Member States to support the sending of UN peacekeepers to protect the 15 nuclear reactors in Ukraine, in close cooperation with the mission of the International Atomic Energy Agency; stresses that UN General Assembly Resolution 377 (V) gives the General Assembly subsidiary decision-making powers when the Security Council is not in a position to take adequate decisions on peacekeeping matters;
